feed.title: Awesome Egocentric Atlas updates
feed.subtitle: Recently added egocentric AI resources, newest first.

entry.title: WorldRover-10M
entry.summary: Synthetic minute-scale world explorations rendered from first-person, third-person, and 360-degree views with RGB, metric depth, camera trajectories, action signals, optical flow, and long-range 2D/3D tracks

entry.title: WNM-3D
entry.summary: Continuous-VLN world navigation model conditioning future-view and action generation on 3D scene tokens reconstructed from monocular ego-view history, evaluated on GN-Bench

entry.title: Vision-Language Models for Egocentric Video
entry.summary: Critical survey connecting egocentric VLMs across hand-object interaction, temporal reasoning, efficient clip selection, graph/object-centric reasoning, wearable assistance, and embodied AI

entry.title: VideoNIG
entry.summary: Goal-oriented navigation-instruction benchmark with 60K simulated ego-view tour videos and 37K text- or image-goal prompts, evaluated by language, spatial-consistency, and navigation-execution tests

entry.title: VLAff / EgoAffordance
entry.summary: EgoAffordance contains 204K episodes with 5.6M visual affordances and 11.6M grasp and trajectory affordances; VLAff predicts heatmaps, grasp poses, and executable trajectories

entry.title: VITRA Egocentric Instruction Sidecars
entry.summary: 175,327 Qwen3.5-generated candidate hand-action instructions with 95,831 accepted rows across GigaHands, HOT3D, and OakInk2; 317 repository files retain exact source revisions and paths

entry.title: UniDataPro Egocentric Video Sample
entry.summary: Commercial card claims 4,050 hours across Pico VR, motion trackers, IMU, quaternion orientation, and ZED stereo capture; the public 2.33 GB repository contains one video, one metadata row, and one tracking file

entry.title: SoniSpeech
entry.summary: 34 hours and 18,000 voiced and silent utterances with synchronized ultrasound echoes, audio, and frontal video; 5,356 unique words and full phoneme coverage

entry.title: SmartRes
entry.summary: Dynamic pixel-space resolution routing for Ego4D and EgoIntention grounding, reducing visual tokens by up to 67%, retaining 86.4% of full-resolution performance, and reporting up to 1.66x faster inference

entry.title: SiMDex
entry.summary: Similarity-based mining selects about 1.49M task-relevant samples from a pool of roughly 32M egocentric human samples and raises reported dexterous-manipulation success from 47.7% to 61.1% over equal-sized random sampling

entry.title: SLT 2026 SmartGlasses Challenge
entry.summary: 106.98 hours across 714 four-channel smart-glasses audio sessions: 518 dyadic sessions totaling 44.95 hours and 196 multi-party meetings totaling 62.03 hours

entry.title: SCOUT
entry.summary: Recovery-aware Chain-of-Tool-Thought agent for hours-to-days egocentric video, with adaptive region switching, uncertainty-prioritized UPS-GRPO, and turn-level temporal-alignment rewards

entry.title: RoboReact
entry.summary: Agentic pipeline that generates egocentric RGB-D manipulation video from a single observation, extracts geometry-preserving keyframes, retargets them to humanoids, and refines execution through closed-loop VLM guidance

entry.title: RoboLab-EgoX
entry.summary: 4,000 simulation episodes and six hours across 28 RoboLab tasks and 99 scenes, including 632 successes and 3,368 failures with wrist-view RGB-D, two exterior RGB-D views, calibration, arm telemetry, actions, and language

entry.title: RoboEdit
entry.summary: Edits human manipulation video into action-consistent robot video with aligned 3D states; the reported RoboEdit-14M corpus contains 174K paired videos, 14M frames, and seven robot embodiments

entry.title: RekaDaily-10k (raw)
entry.summary: Incremental raw release currently containing 7,834 hours, 397,171 videos, 9,836 WebDataset shards, and about 70 TB of unscripted first-person daily-life footage from head-mounted and handheld phones

entry.title: RealFactory-Ego-Data
entry.summary: Five head-mounted episodes totaling about 14 minutes on a live touchscreen production line, with RGB, 21-landmark hand pose, and frame-level action boundaries in LeRobot-compatible packages

entry.title: ROCO IROS 2026 UMI Dataset
entry.summary: 4,928 LeRobot v3 episodes and 7,459,440 frames across five tasks at 30 fps, with stereo first-person video, four hand-camera streams, and 16D bimanual pose and gripper state/action

entry.title: R4DSG
entry.summary: Relative 4D scene-graph memory evaluated on 255 object questions from EgoLifeQA; reports a 6.7-point overall gain and a 12.5-point gain on when questions over EgoRAG-Text

entry.title: Proxemic Risk from Robot Ego Images
entry.summary: Four-level proxemic-danger classification study comparing InternVL, Qwen-VL, and SmolVLM under three prompts and two QLoRA rounds, with a separate person-localization analysis

entry.title: Omega-0
entry.summary: Latent predictive whole-body world-action model supporting ego RGB plus exocentric RGB/depth; reports Omega-HOME with 40+ hours of synchronized household humanoid observations, motion, states, and action latents

entry.title: OccPlanner
entry.summary: Pixel-goal diffusion planner conditioned on local 3D occupancy, with L3ROcc supervision reconstructed from monocular robot videos; reports 71.55% average success at 5-8 m versus 20.81% for NavDP

entry.title: Nexdata 10,000-Hour Egocentric Video Dataset
entry.summary: Commercial card describes 10,000 hours across residential, retail, and office scenes with PICO 4 Ultra 4K stereo video, wrist and ankle IMU, 76-point full-body pose, and dense action annotations

entry.title: NVIDIA Video-to-Data Robot Dexterity Dataset
entry.summary: 1,215 TACO-derived human motion sequences retargeted into 121,500 bimanual Sharpa robot episodes and 1,215 motion parquets, totaling 924.8 GB in Parquet and LeRobot v3 formats

entry.title: MERIT
entry.summary: Simple episodic memory with four retrieval keys per 30-second clip and query-time neighbor filtering; reports 71.2 accuracy on EgoLifeQA, 71.8 on LVBench, and 77.7 on Video-MME Long with a GPT-5 backbone

entry.title: Long-Tail Embodied Urban Navigation from In-the-Wild Videos
entry.summary: Automatically annotates web-scale in-the-wild egocentric videos with metric trajectories and structured navigation semantics, then trains a VLA policy while exposing rare perception-motion failure modes

entry.title: LAWM-3D
entry.summary: 3D-aware latent-action learning from multiview human video using invariant action tokenization, geometric foundation-model alignment, and RGB-D reconstruction for robot world-model pretraining

entry.title: JoyAI-RA 0.5
entry.summary: Vision-Language-World-Action framework aligning action-free human egocentric video, simulation, and robot trajectories through latent and canonical action spaces for generalist manipulation

entry.title: InfoBayAI Egocentric Video Sample
entry.summary: Auto-gated 31.87 GB repository containing 10 MP4 sample videos and one metadata Parquet file; the card separately advertises a 229,189-hour collection that is not present in the public manifest

entry.title: InHandPlus Wrist-View Camera and IMU Sample
entry.summary: Auto-gated 30-episode, 119.7 MiB early sample for cloth folding and organization, with wrist video, synchronized 6-axis raw IMU, and LeRobot v3 metadata but no action labels
